faq.question: Q1. What is the organization name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Punjab Agricultural University (PAU). It is a well-known agricultural university located in Punjab, India, offering various academic and research opportunities.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name available in PAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post available in the PAU Recruitment 2026 is Lab Helper. This position is crucial for supporting laboratory operations and research activities within the university.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for Lab Helper?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Lab Helper post in the current PAU Recruitment 2026. This is a contractual position offering a stable role.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for PAU Lab Helper posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for PAU Lab Helper posts is Offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it, and send it by post to the specified address before the deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to apply for these posts?
faq.answer: The last date to receive the application for the Lab Helper posts is 14 August 2026. Candidates must ensure their application reaches the university by this date.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required educational qualification for Lab Helper?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Lab Helper post must have passed Middle school with Punjabi as a subject. This qualification ensures basic literacy and local language proficiency.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for Lab Helper posts?
faq.answer: The age limit for Lab Helper posts is a minimum of 18 years and a maximum of 63 years. This broad age range allows a diverse group of candidates to apply.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for Lab Helper at PAU?
faq.answer: The salary for the Lab Helper post at PAU is Rs. 13,486/- per month, plus an additional Rs. 800/- p.m. fixed. This offers a competitive remuneration package for the role.

faq.question: Q9. What is the application fee for PAU Lab Helper Recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee for PAU Lab Helper Recruitment is Rs. 100/- for all categories, including General/OBC and SC/ST. This fee must be paid along with the application form.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for Lab Helper posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for Lab Helper posts includes Document Verification followed by an Interview. Candidates will be assessed based on their qualifications and performance in the interview.
